notes.title: Demo Patch 2.1.: the last update before the full release
notes.notes:
[p]Thank you for joining us on this journey. Today we’re releasing [b]Demo 2.1, the last update before the full game launches[/b]. This version polishes the experience and sets the stage for what’s to come.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What’s new:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Stargazer battle overhaul:[/b] now more deeply connected to the cosmos. Expect a spectacle of stars, energy, and celestial wonder that will leave you in awe.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Character portraits added:[/b] it’s time to meet Henry, his chickens, and the mysterious (and not-so-mysterious) inhabitants and visitors of Arcton, now with their own faces, expressions, and secrets.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Visual improvements:[/b] the entire demo area has been polished with enhanced graphics and atmosphere.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New soundscapes:[/b] music volumes have been adjusted, new sound effects added, and—wait, was that an owl or just your imagination? The forest of Arcton sounds more alive than ever.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Coins...?[/b] A few have begun to appear… but who left them, and why, remains a mystery.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for playing, sharing, and being part of this world.
Next stop: the full release.[/p][p][/p][p]See you very soon.[/p][p]Moss Tower Studio Team[/p]

notes.title: Demo 2.0 patch: new areas, improved mechanics and gameplay
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
We’ve been hard at work refining the demo as we prepare for the upcoming acts of Cosmic Horror Tales. Patch 2.0 brings a range of improvements aimed at enhancing both gameplay and immersion. Here’s what’s new:

[b]1. New Tutorial Area[/b]
Dive deeper into Henry’s life and uncover the reasons behind his current mission. The revamped tutorial offers a more narrative-driven introduction to the story.

[b]2. Expanded Mechanics[/b]
Players can now run, jump across gaps, climb, and interact with objects more fluidly, allowing for richer and more dynamic exploration.

[b]3. Redesigned Menu System[/b]
The new in-game menu offers improved organization for items, clues, characters, light sources, and character upgrades, helping players stay informed as the story unfolds.

[b]4. Enhanced Atmosphere & Audio[/b]
We’ve added ambient and navigational sounds to the user interface, along with new audio cues to further immerse players in key story moments.

[b]5. Stargazer Updates[/b]
Our mysterious Stargazer has received a minor visual refresh and some small gameplay tweaks.

[b]6. Improved Navigation & Hidden Paths[/b]
We’ve added new hidden passages and made adjustments to level layout, making exploration more rewarding and the overall journey more intuitive.

[b]7. Bug Fixes & Performance[/b]
Resolved several issues related to the pause menu and implemented performance optimizations to ensure a smoother experience.

Thanks for playing the demo and for all the feedback so far! Your support helps us shape the future of [i]Cosmic Horror Tales[/i].
